FCDO Foreign Travel Advice — Iran
Last updated: 18 June 2026 (still the current version as checked 18/19 July 2026)
=> IMPORTANT: NOT updated on Saturday 18 July 2026. No new FCDO Iran advice that day.

ADVICE LEVEL: FCDO advises against all travel to Iran.

KEY LINES (page text):
- British nationals should "keep your departure plans under review, and ensure your travel
  documents are up to date."
- Those in Iran should "carefully consider your presence there and the risks you take by staying."
- Airspace may close suddenly; land borders may restrict foreign travellers and close without notice.
- Border crossing guidance given for Turkey, Azerbaijan, Turkmenistan and Armenia.
- "if you intend to leave overland you do so at your own risk"
